issues.description: `PageTableEntryPerms::wf` guards every per-entry invariant with `len < 512` while also requiring `len == 512`, making all 512 PTE well-formedness obligations vacuous.
issues.rationale: The selected predicate requires self.inner.value().len() == 512, but its quantified implication uses 0 <= self.inner.value().len() < 512 rather than bounding the quantified index. The implication antecedent is therefore false for every i, so a fully initialized 512-entry array with a malformed PTE at any valid index can satisfy this clause without Pte::wf or wf_with_node_info. Repair commit 7b2e349ad7b7d17f70237d009b6cb938da9fb8bd changes the antecedent to 0 <= i < 512 and removes external_body from both read_pte paths and write_pte using the restored per-index facts.
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/exec/rw/node/rwlock/mod.rs:316-330 simultaneously requires len == 512 and guards each PTE obligation with len < 512. Repair 7b2e349ad7b7d17f70237d009b6cb938da9fb8bd changes lines 320-329 to quantify i: int with 0 <= i < 512, indexes value()[i], and passes i as nat to wf_with_node_info. The same repair removes the three accessor external_body annotations in lock-protocol/src/exec/rw/node/mod.rs and adds proofs using these indexed facts.
issues.verification: Historical compatibility verification executed with asterinas/verus 0b6f3cbb8fceff6681b4988c3cac37a8b801f8e6, Rust 1.88.0, and Z3 4.12.5. vstd_extra verified 228/0. Problem lock-protocol verified 491/0, but the implication was vacuous and all three accessors were external bodies. Repair and final lock-protocol verified 494/0 after the invariant correction and exemption removal. The verifier is nine days newer than the PR; the contradictory length guard is tool-independent source logic.
